title: Greenville Run Club (Monday nights)
recurrence: Every Monday, 6:45 PM (meets at The Commons / Pangaea Brewing)
description: Social run (300+ people in summer) to Cancer Survivors Park and back, then hangs at the brewery. No signup, just show up. Check Instagram for winter schedule changes.

title: Running for Brews 5K Social Run (Tuesday nights)
description: Free 3-mile run/walk from the brewery, then beers. RSVP on Meetup.

title: Fleet Feet Pub Run (Thursday nights)
description: Free weekly 3.1-mile run or walk starting from a different brewery each week. Check the Fleet Feet page or Facebook group for this week's location.

title: Southernside Brewing Trivia Night (Wednesdays)
description: Weekly trivia on the patio. Teams of up to 6; show up by 6:45 to grab a table.

title: Christ Church Young Adults (23-39) - Third Thursdays
recurrence: Third Thursday of each month, 5:30 PM
description: Monthly social for young adults plus quarterly service projects.

title: 20's & 30's Social Meetup of Greenville (monthly events)
description: Downtown events, hikes, happy hours and volunteering with other young professionals.

title: Single Scene Greenville mixers (every two weeks)
recurrence: Every other week; dates posted on Instagram/Eventbrite
description: Singles mixers with wristbands that show dating status. Check Instagram for the next date.

title: Greenville Chamber Young Professionals (GCYP) events
recurrence: Monthly socials and leadership luncheons; ages 21-39
description: Formerly Pulse. Membership-based YP program with monthly networking socials.

title: Greenville Clemson Club socials
recurrence: Roughly monthly, usually a brewery on a Thursday 5:30-7 PM
description: Clemson alumni happy hours and watch parties around Greenville.

title: Tech After Five - Greenville
description: Open networking happy hour for tech professionals and anyone tech-curious.

title: Greenville Sports Leagues - seasonal coed leagues
recurrence: Seasons start roughly Jan, Mar, Jun, Sep; register as a free agent
description: Coed kickball, volleyball, softball, pickleball, cornhole. Free agents are placed on a team.
